hash_semantics: SHA-256 describes exact source checkout bytes copied to source/. Source HEAD is the base; source_dirty explicitly qualifies any uncommitted bytes. No private payload was inventoried or hashed. Git may normalize text line endings; verification accepts only exact bytes or the documented LF text equivalent. Binary bytes must match exactly.
exclusions: local runtime/business/account stores (.local and credential stores)
real .env/.dev.vars, credentials, secrets and key files
owner attachments, local Font directory and private inputs
provider credentials and raw auth/session/token hashes from runtime stores
included_configuration: Tracked Wrangler instance/site/client identifiers and contact addresses are configuration, not bearer credentials. Blank .dev.vars.example is a safe template.
